painTitle: Referrals built the practice. They won't scale it.

pain.heading: Growth waits on referrals
pain.body: New clients arrive when an existing client or another accountant happens to recommend you. Business development fits between deadlines, so the pipeline rises and falls with the compliance calendar.

pain.heading: Fee pressure from cheaper providers
pain.body: Prospects who find you through a price comparison treat finance work as a commodity. You end up defending your fees instead of the judgment and reporting that set your firm apart.

pain.heading: Outreach feels risky in a trust business
pain.body: Finance clients hire on discretion and reputation. A generic, automated message under a partner's name can do more harm than sending nothing at all.

flowTitle:
From target list to finance-head consultation
In your voice, approved by you

flowTop.title: ICP & Trigger Mapping
flowTop.body: Define the businesses you serve best by size, sector and finance setup, and the moments they look for help: a funding round, a new entity, an audit or compliance cycle, a gap in the finance team.

flowTop.title: Verified Decision-Maker Lists
flowTop.body: Founders, CFOs, finance controllers and HR heads at those companies, or managing partners at accounting practices that need extra delivery capacity.

flowTop.title: Voice Capture
flowTop.body: One onboarding call captures how your partners describe their work, so every message reads as theirs and not as a template.

flowParallel.title: Partner Profile Optimisation
flowParallel.body: Headline, banner and about section positioned around the advisory outcome you deliver, not a list of services.

flowParallel.title: Insight-Led Content
flowParallel.body: On managed plans, posts on cash flow, management reporting and compliance timing build recognition before outreach lands.

flowParallel.title: Confidentiality First
flowParallel.body: No client names or engagement details in outreach without written permission. Messages lead with the problem you solve.

flowBottom.title: Launch Approved Outreach
flowBottom.body: LinkedIn and cold email go live only after a partner approves the messages, sent from dedicated infrastructure set up for deliverability.

flowBottom.title: Qualify on Real Need
flowBottom.body: Follow-ups establish the prospect's current finance setup, service gaps and review timing before a call is booked.

flowBottom.title: Book Consultations
flowBottom.body: Qualified founders and finance heads land in your calendar with context, so the first call starts with their situation.

process.title: Onboarding & Voice Capture
process.body: A 1 to 2 hour onboarding call covers the clients you want more of, the services you lead with and how your partners talk about their work.

process.title: Targeting & Lists
process.body: We map businesses by size, sector and finance trigger, then verify the founders and finance leaders to contact. No recycled databases.

process.title: Partner-Approved Messaging
process.body: Message drafts go to a partner before anything is sent. Outreach opens on a specific need, such as monthly management reporting or payroll review timing, not a service menu.

process.title: Consultations Booked
process.body: We handle replies, qualify interest and book consultations into your calendar. Proposals, pricing and the advice itself stay with your firm.

caseCards.headline: Connecting a bookkeeping firm with accounting practices
caseCards.body: A bookkeeping services company wanted partnerships with UK accounting practices that needed extra delivery capacity. We contacted managing partners and operations heads with messages about workload and overflow support, not a generic pitch.

caseCards.headline: Finding businesses that need outsourced finance support
caseCards.body: A Singapore outsourced CFO and accounting firm won most new clients through accountants and founder referrals. We reached founders, managing directors and finance leaders with outreach on specific needs, such as monthly management reports or senior finance support.

caseCards.headline: Building an outsourced payroll pipeline
caseCards.body: An Indian payroll services firm targeting companies with 100 to 500 employees depended on referrals. We reached HR heads, finance controllers and founders, and follow-ups established workforce size, current processes and vendor review timing.

whyTitle: Built for finance firms that sell expertise
whyIntro: Outbound suits firms that can market their services directly. ICAI's Code of Ethics restricts chartered accountants in practice from soliciting clients, so we do not run outreach for Indian CA practices' own services.
